content_text:
hello sir, my recent project is set to stream on Amazon prime. The requirement is to deliver 4kUHD in HDR and 4kUHD in SDR.
I wanted to ask if you have graded footage separately for HDR and SDR.
my test exports which I viewed on a LG 55 inch OLED screen showed the HDR footage to match very closely to my DI monitor but the SDR looked oversaturated.
do I regrade the SDR exports to make it less saturated ? Or could it be that the OLED display somehow enhances saturation for the SDR exports and would look closer to the set saturation on a standard LED display.
